events.label: mount-panels
events.source:
local function checked(ok, err) if not ok then error(err) end end
for _, scope in ipairs({'visit', 'room', 'session'}) do
  local owner = scope == 'visit' and 'current-room' or scope
  checked(noveltea.layouts.mount(scope .. '-panel', scope .. '-counter', {owner=owner, room=scope == 'room' and 'layout-counter' or nil, clock='unscaled-presentation', inputs={scope=scope, caption=scope .. ' panel', stock={variable='panel-stock'}, owner_label={property='panel-label', target={kind='room',id='layout-counter'}}, mode={facet='runtime-mode'}, current_room={facet='current-room'}, paused={facet='gameplay-paused'}}, signals={'accepted'}}))
end
checked(noveltea.layouts.mount('resource-fragment', 'counter-fragment', {owner='current-room', input='normal'}))

source.text: Commit a Slot in each panel. Save at this boundary, hide/unmount and reopen, or Continue to end the Flow owner. Leave and revisit through the HUD exit to renew the visit; named Room and session panels survive.
